product.name: Workstream by Monoprice Under Desk Power Supply and Wire Management Cable Tray Organizer Steel White
product.description: This Cable Tray Organizer helps with managing messy wires and power adapters that plague today's work desks. Hide unsightly cords and bricks and regain precious desk space. It is designed to work with Monoprice sit-stand desks to allow for easy height adjustment, but it also works with most kinds of work tables and computer desks.Made of steel for a durable platform, it can hold power strips, power adapters, and various cables to help keep wires in order. It is attached by screws under most wood or wood-composite desks.Features: Attaches under desktops and designed to move with height-adjustable desksAlso works with regular desks to keep cables, power strips, surge protectors, and power adapters hidden and organizedPrevents wire tangles especially when moving desks up or downMinimalist design to hide unsightly cable clutterPowder coated steel for durabilityWorks with wood or wood-composite tabletopsSupport Files: Dimensions Diagram (Aug 14, 2018)
